sloka: त्वत्सकाशाद्दशग्रीवः संस्कारं विधिपूर्वकम् ।प्राप्तुमर्हति धर्मज्ञ त्वं यशोभाग् भविष्यसि ।। ६.११४.१०२ ।।
transliteration: tvatsakāśāddaśagrīvaḥ saṁskāraṁ vidhipūrvakam ।prāptumarhati dharmajña tvaṁ yaśobhāg bhaviṣyasi ।। 6.114.102 ।।

translations.english: "There is no hostility after death for heroes. Let us perform his obsequies. I am also like that in this regard.
